description: Jet 4 MDB: parity of Recordset property 'Update Criteria' values 0..3 on W: opens all 8 client batch Recordsets first (rows 1..4 same-col S vs S, rows 5..8 diff-col V2 vs S), runs all 8 external UPDATEs on cn2 and closes cn2 (releasing Jet 4 page locks cleanly), then runs UpdateBatch on each Recordset. Records Errors, Recordset.Status, Value/OriginalValue, and kept page bytes.

args.text: SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 1
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 5
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 2
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 6
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 3
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 7
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 4
SELECT ID, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID = 8
UPDATE W SET S = 'ext1' WHERE ID = 1
UPDATE W SET V2 = V2 + 100 WHERE ID = 5
UPDATE W SET S = 'ext2' WHERE ID = 2
UPDATE W SET V2 = V2 + 100 WHERE ID = 6
UPDATE W SET S = 'ext3' WHERE ID = 3
UPDATE W SET V2 = V2 + 100 WHERE ID = 7
UPDATE W SET S = 'ext4' WHERE ID = 4
UPDATE W SET V2 = V2 + 100 WHERE ID = 8
SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W WHERE ID <= 8 ORDER BY ID
